audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer treated Condemn as a flat 'wall-stun' and never gave its cooldown, never mentioned Tumble's auto reset, and referred to Vayne as 'he' throughout.
audit.why: Riot text: Condemn knocks the target back and deals damage; the impale, bonus damage and stun happen only if they collide with terrain. Cd 20/18/16/14/12, range 550. Tumble is 6/5/4/3/2s with an auto reset at 300 range. Silver Bolts triggers on the third consecutive attack OR ability against the same target, so her E and Q count toward the stack. Final Hour (100/85/70s) grants invisibility during Tumble and cuts Tumble's cooldown.
audit.corrected: Condemn is knockback always, stun only into terrain — stand in open lane. Cooldowns stated, Silver Bolts ability-counting stated, pronouns fixed.

notes: Packet records only 12 games at 25% for this matchup — the win rate on the page should be treated as a small sample, and I did not rewrite any rating off it. Lillia's E carries a derived 'revealsStealth' flag; Riot's description of Swirlseed says nothing about revealing, so I made no claim that it answers Final Hour's Tumble invisibility. Same file's 'terrain: creates terrain' flag on Lillia E is also a tooltip-parse misfire — the seed rolls until it hits a wall, it does not make one.
